patch.value: pm brief diverge: pre-merge multi-agent item collision preview

Adds 'pm brief diverge' subcommand that previews pm item divergence between two git branches BEFORE merging. Shows which items both branches touched and whether the field-aware merge driver will resolve them cleanly (union-safe) or produce a real conflict (field-collision, duplicate-id, delete-vs-edit). Includes a fence check for .gitattributes/git-config merge driver installation. Supports markdown/text/json/slack formats with deterministic ordering and token budgeting.

pm brief diverge previews divergence between base/head git refs: classifies each touched pm item as head-only, base-only, union-safe, field-collision, duplicate-id, or delete-vs-edit; checks merge driver fence (.gitattributes + git config); supports --base/--head/--include-clean/--max-items/--token-budget/--format/--output; deterministic ordering (duplicate-id > delete-vs-edit > field-collision > union-safe > one-sided), tie-break by id; markdown/text/json/slack renderers; pure functions exported and unit-tested; one end-to-end integration test with real git repo; npm run typecheck/build/test pass.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Implemented pm brief diverge: git readers (resolveRepoRoot, resolveRef, detectDefaultBase, mergeBase, listChangedPaths, readBlob), path model (pmRootRelFromCtx), event identity (parseHistoryJsonl, eventKey, newEvents, countMalformedLines), field extraction (changedFieldPaths, normalizeFieldPath, BENIGN_FIELDS), per-item classification (classifyItemDivergence: 6 kinds — head-only, base-only, unchanged, duplicate-id, delete-vs-edit, field-collision, union-safe), fence check (evaluateFence), aggregate (buildDivergence: verdict precedence, deterministic ordering, token budget), 4 renderers (markdown/text/json/slack), command registration with all flags. 27 unit tests + 1 end-to-end integration test (real git repo + real pm CLI). Gates: typecheck OK, build OK, 86/86 tests pass, changelog:check OK. Production proof: ran all 4 formats against a real divergent git repo — verdict review-required, item1 field-collision on /metadata/status, item2 union-safe (priority vs assignee), item3 base-only. Co-Authored-By: pi-agent <noreply@anthropic.com>

value.author: claude
value.text:
Independent verification (claude, 2026-07-24): gates green in worktree — typecheck rc=0, build OK, 88/88 tests pass (86 from pi + 2 added for the fixes below).

REAL-DATA GROUND-TRUTH PROOF: built a scratch git repo (3 items, field-aware fence installed via pm merge install), branched agent-a (I1 status=in_progress, I2 priority=3) and agent-b from the same ancestor (I1 status=blocked, I2 assignee=bob, I3 title). 'pm brief diverge --base agent-b' predicted: I1 field-collision on /metadata/status, I2 union-safe (assignee vs priority), I3 base-only, verdict review-required, fence ok. Then ran the actual 'git merge agent-b': it CONFLICTED on exactly .agents/pm/tasks/<I1>.toon and auto-merged <I2>.toon cleanly — prediction matched ground truth item-for-item. All four formats (markdown/json/text/slack) render.

EDGE CASES verified live: clean verdict when only head advances; --include-clean lists the one-sided item; fence-missing reports both missing pieces (.gitattributes entries + merge.*.driver config) and puts 'pm merge install' first; duplicate-id detected as high severity with 'pm history <id> --verify' recommended; unknown ref exits 2 with a clear message.

TWO DEFECTS FOUND AND FIXED during verification:
1. Unrelated histories were only disclosed in markdown prose. JSON.stringify drops the undefined ancestorSha, so a JSON consumer saw verdict=clean with no way to know there was no merge base. Added an explicit always-present unrelatedHistories boolean + JSON round-trip test.
2. The recommended command was a bare 'git merge <base>' even with no merge base, which git refuses outright ('refusing to merge unrelated histories'). Now emits 'git merge --allow-unrelated-histories <base>' in that case only.
Also documented the command in README (it was entirely undocumented).
